CREATE TEMPORARY EXTERNAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS test_db.test_table ( id INT PRIMARY KEY DISABLE NOVALIDATE, name STRING NOT NULL COMMENT 'User name', age INT CHECK (age > 0 AND age < 150) ENABLE NOVALIDATE RELY, email STRING UNIQUE DISABLE NOVALIDATE NORELY, score DOUBLE DEFAULT 0.0, address STRUCT < city:STRING, street:STRING > , hobbies ARRAY < STRING > , metadata MAP < STRING, STRING > , info UNIONTYPE < INT, STRING > ) COMMENT 'Test table with all Hive optional clauses' PARTITIONED BY (dt STRING COMMENT 'Partition date', country STRING COMMENT 'Country') CLUSTERED BY (id) SORTED BY (score DESC) INTO 4 BUCKETS SKEWED BY (name) ON (('Alice', 'Bob'), ('Charlie', 'David')) STORED AS DIRECTORIES ROW FORMAT SERDE 'org.apache.hadoop.hive.serde2.lazy.LazySimpleSerDe' WITH SERDEPROPERTIES ('field.delim'='\t', 'collection.delim'=',', 'mapkey.delim'=':') STORED AS ORC LOCATION '/user/hive/warehouse/test_db.db/test_table' TBLPROPERTIES ( 'owner'='admin', 'version'='1.0', 'orc.compress'='SNAPPY', 'transactional'='true' ) AS SELECT u.id, u.name, u.age, u.email, u.score, named_struct('city', u.city, 'street', u.street) AS address, split(u.hobbies, ',') AS hobbies, str_to_map(u.metadata, ',', '=') AS metadata, case when u.flag = 1 then create_union(0, u.id) else create_union(1, u.name) end AS info, ds.dt, u.country FROM source_users u JOIN dim_dates ds ON u.date_id = ds.date_id WHERE u.status = 'active';
